description: Source code implementing streaming and filtering mechanisms for object database in Git, including stream structures, read functions, and stream filtering logic.

classes.name: odb_filtered_read_stream
classes.description: Stream structure for filtered reading with buffer management and filter application.

classes.name: odb_incore_read_stream
classes.description: In-core stream structure for reading object data directly from memory.

methods.name: close_istream_filtered
methods.description: Closes filtered stream and frees associated filter.

methods.name: read_istream_filtered
methods.description: Reads data from filtered stream, applying stream filter.

methods.name: attach_stream_filter
methods.description: Attaches a stream filter to an existing stream.

methods.name: close_istream_incore
methods.description: Closes in-core stream and frees buffer.

methods.name: read_istream_incore
methods.description: Reads data from in-core stream buffer.

methods.name: open_istream_incore
methods.description: Opens an in-core stream by reading object info.

methods.name: istream_source
methods.description: Provides a stream source for an object, trying packfile, alternates, then in-core.

methods.name: odb_read_stream_read
methods.description: Reads data from a read stream.

methods.name: odb_read_stream_open
methods.description: Opens a read stream for an object, with optional filter.

methods.name: odb_stream_blob_to_fd
methods.description: Streams object blob data directly to a file descriptor, with optional filtering and seeking.
